args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py::round_money` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which broke the nightly build because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed (tests/test_money.py green).
